# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
The purpose of this document is to define the requirements for enabling SKU-level stock transfer between different articles without enforcing existing system restrictions such as Product Group validation or requirement linkage.
This enhancement aims to provide operational flexibility in managing stock reclassification, correction, and adjustments across articles.

# 1.2 Scope
This functionality will allow authorized users to:
• Transfer stock between any two articles at SKU level
• Perform transfers without dependency on:
• Product Group
• Indent/Order requirement
• Ensure stock movement is restricted only to free stock
The scope includes:
• UI changes in Stock Transfer/Adjustment screen
• Backend validation updates
• Transaction logging
• Reporting enhancements

# Section 2.

# Assumptions

# Section 3.

# Functional Requirements

### Current Functionality
In the existing system:
• Article creation is governed by Product Group classification
• Stock transfer (Equivalent Adjustment) is allowed only when:
• Both articles belong to the same Product Group
• Both share the same Storage UOM
• There is an active requirement (Indent/Order)
• Cross-product-group transfers are restricted
• Indent inhouse adjustment screen
Material reallocation screen.

### Limitations
• Inflexibility in stock correction
• Difficulty in handling wrongly classified stock
• Dependency on order/indent creates operational delays

## 3. Business Requirement
The client requires:
• Unrestricted SKU-level stock transfer between articles
• Removal of:
• Product Group validation
• Requirement dependency
• Ability to transfer stock even if:
• Articles belong to different Product Groups
• No active order/indent exists

### Business Use Cases
• Correction of wrongly mapped articles
• Reclassification of similar materials
• Adjustment of excess or misallocated stock
• Warehouse reconciliation scenarios

## 4. Functional Requirements
We required that system should allow the material adjustment without validation the product group sub category or UOM.
In both Indent inhouse adjustment page and material reallocation page.
System should only allow to allocate the free stock and it should be user restricted by which only the selected user can be given permission to perform such activity.
Process flow
User Initiates Adjustment
↓
Select From Material / SKU
↓
Select To Material / SKU
↓
System Checks Free Stock
↓
[If Free Stock Available]
↓
Allow Adjustment (No Validation Check)
↓
Update Stock
↓
Generate Transaction Log

#### Step 3: Validation Logic
System must validate:

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 4 rows · columns: Validation Type (text), Description (text) · identifiers: Validation Type]
| Validation Type | Description |
| Available Stock | Ensure sufficient stock exists |
| Free Stock Check | Only unreserved stock allowed |
| Product Group Validation | Not Applicable (Removed) |
| Requirement Validation | Not Required |

#### Step 4: Stock Movement Execution
Upon successful validation:
• Deduct stock from:
• From Article + SKU
• Add stock to:
• To Article + SKU

#### Step 5: Transaction Recording
System must generate a unique transaction record with:
• Transaction ID
• Transaction Date & Time
• From Article / SKU
• To Article / SKU
• Quantity & UOM
• Price
• Transaction Type
→ Inter-Article Stock Transfer (No Validation)
• User ID
• Remarks

## 5. Non-Functional Requirements

### 5.1 Performance
• Transaction execution time should be < 3 seconds
• System should support bulk SKU selection without lag

### 5.2 Security
• Access restricted via Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
• Only authorized users can perform transfers

### 5.3 Auditability
• Complete audit trail required for:
• Creation
• Modification
• Reversal

### 5.4 Data Integrity
• Ensure no negative stock scenarios
• Ensure transactional consistency (atomic operations)

## 6. Reporting Requirements

### 6.1 Stock Transfer Report
Enhance existing or create new report including:
• Transaction Number
• Date & Time
• From Article / SKU
• To Article / SKU
• Quantity & UOM
• Price
• Product Group (Both Articles)
• User ID
• Remarks
• Transaction Type

### 6.2 Filters
• Date Range
• Article
• SKU
• User
• Transaction Type

## Constraints
• Only Free Stock can be transferred
• Storage UOM remains non-editable
• No impact on existing equivalent adjustment functionality
• Reversal must follow standard stock reversal flow

## Risks & Mitigation

[TABLE 2: Table 2 · 3 rows · columns: Risk (text), Impact (text), Mitigation (text)]
| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
| Incorrect stock transfer | Inventory mismatch | Restrict access via roles |
| Misuse of feature | Data inconsistency | Maintain audit logs |
| Cross-article confusion | Reporting complexity | Include clear transaction tagging |

## Acceptance Criteria
The feature will be considered complete when:
• User can transfer stock across different Product Groups
• No dependency on indent/order exists
• Only free stock is transferable
• Transaction logs are generated correctly
• Reports reflect accurate transfer data
• Role-based restriction is enforced
